# couchbase-capella-aidp_models (Data Source)

Lists Capella AI models in an organization. Optional `model_status` and `model_kind` query filters are supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella-aidp_models" "example" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  model_status    = "healthy"
  model_kind      = "embedding-generation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String)

### Optional

- `model_kind` (String) Filter by model kind: `text-generation` or `embedding-generation`.
- `model_status` (String) Filter by model status (e.g. healthy, deploying, paused).
